active_threats.name: TRAI / Digital Arrest Scam
active_threats.description: Fraudsters claim the victim's phone number will be blocked due to illegal activity (harassment, drugs) and transfer calls to fake 'CBI' or 'Cyber Police', demanding a 'security deposit' to unfreeze accounts.

active_threats.name: Telegram Task / ROI Trap
active_threats.description: Victims are offered part-time jobs liking YouTube videos or reviewing hotels. They are paid small amounts initially, then forced to invest in 'prepaid tasks' or 'crypto VIP tiers' to withdraw earnings.

active_threats.name: Malicious APK Smishing
active_threats.description: SMS messages mimicking India Post, Electricity Boards, or Banks asking users to download an APK file to update KYC or pay pending bills. The APK steals SMS OTPs in the background.
